name: prometheus-skills-mini
__projectId_note: kbd-memory-log derives the memory entity id from `.project // .projectId`, which the kbd-init template never writes; without this key every lifecycle event from this repo is filed under `unknown/`.
description: Windows-native, scaled-down port of prometheus-skill-pack: KBD + PMPO skills, OpenSpec, Karpathy logging, Nunjucks templates, Rust toolkit skills — Node.js-only scripts, two Docker-managed services.
__worktreeRoot_note: Template default, kept verbatim because the installed KBD skills (bash originals) expand ${HOME} themselves. This repo's own code must never read it that way — use os.homedir(). Revisit when the Node port of kbd-new-child lands.
__ux_profile_note: advanced → kbd-status is dense by default; beginner → kbd-status --explain is on by default (expands decision-log entries + next-and-why narrative). Verbosity only — never gates information.
__build_health_command_note: Derived from package.json scripts by /kbd-init --force on 2026-09-21, after project-scaffold landed. Was the literal node command while no manifest existed.
__lint_command_note: No linter is configured in this repo and none was invented. Per-file syntax feedback is `node --check <file>` (tier T0 in .claude/rules/node-scripts.md).
__command_policy: Every command here must run identically from cmd.exe, Windows PowerShell 5.1, bash and zsh: no `&&` chaining (PowerShell 5.1 rejects it), double quotes only, no grep/sed/jq/awk/curl. Nothing that starts Docker belongs in a trigger — that is tier T3.
__preferred_planning_agent_note: AGENTS.md has no Agent-Specific Notes section. The kbd-init default is `antigravity`, but this repo has no Antigravity configuration; `openspec init` configured Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. Chosen from that evidence — change freely.

model_policy.__note: Template defaults, unverified for this project. README §7 puts local model inference out of scope on 16 GB, which conflicts with the `local` Qwen entries below; the judge and critic resolve through liter-llm (kbd-judge / kbd-critic) at a higher precedence than this block. Needs an owner decision.

strengths: parallel isolated tasks via git worktrees

workspace.__note: Five .code-workspace files exist in the parent directories; none lists this project, so this is single-project mode. The reference folder below was added by hand, not discovered: this repo is a port of it, it is read constantly, and it has live worktrees — write drift into it is the real risk the role system exists for.

folders.purpose: Active project — all KBD operations target this directory
Port source. Read skills, hooks, shared scripts and Docker assets from here; never write. Its bash/Python is the behaviour to reproduce in Node, not code to copy.

__coverage_command_note: Runs BOTH reports in one command (no && — PowerShell 5.1): the in-process one, and the child-process one for rules/build.mjs that the default reporter cannot see. Fails below threshold.
__spec_validate_command_note: Was `openspec validate --all --no-interactive`, which cannot work on Windows: npm installs the CLI as openspec.cmd and Node cannot run a .cmd without a shell. Now goes through scripts/spec-validate.mjs → spawnNodeCli → the CLI's JavaScript entry.
